scope: Scoped visual review of five complete current exported historical-map viewports. Independent numerical shader verification is in relief_shade_native_evidence.json; these are actual game views, not synthetic fixtures.
observations: Inspected mountain and tributary views show continuous ground lighting with the normal HUD and source-derived scenery. Visible material/control polygons persist independently of this hillshade change.
Thin headwater banks are subdued and their source bends are retained. Main-channel Hankou/Nanjing ribbons remain connected at the inspected scale, including the mobile layout.
No claim is made that these five views validate every relief location, scale or artistic composition. Mountain miniatures and repetitive ground identities require further art work.
remaining_visual_issues: Polygonal material and control-area transitions remain visible.
Mountain silhouettes and spacing still read as placed miniatures.
Several regional base textures have insufficient structural distinction at gameplay scale.
